entries.source_note: Speeds up dialogue text. Guard re-read byte for byte from the 1.2.3 ARM9 image on 20 September 2026 and it matches; the in-game proof was made on 1.04 and has not been repeated on 1.2.3. Restart without the cheat to restore the original code.

Shortens map-change fades; it is not an FPS unlock. Guard re-read byte for byte from the 1.2.3 ARM9 image on 20 September 2026 and it matches; the in-game proof was made on 1.04 and has not been repeated on 1.2.3.

Shortens Pokemon Center healing animations; HP, status and PP are restored as usual. It only acts while the Center overlay is loaded. Guard re-read byte for byte from the 1.2.3 ARM9 image on 20 September 2026 and it matches; the in-game proof was made on 1.04 and has not been repeated on 1.2.3. Its second guard is in that overlay and is not statically verifiable.

Disables 3D edge marking and keeps the existing DS anti-aliasing; it does not raise the resolution. Enter and leave a building after enabling it. Its guard lives in a map overlay, so it cannot be checked against the static ARM9 image: neither a static nor an in-game proof exists for 1.2.3.

Lets the Name Rater rename Pokemon from other Trainers; the name persists if you save. Guard re-read byte for byte from the 1.2.3 ARM9 image on 20 September 2026 and it matches; the in-game proof was made on 1.04 and has not been repeated on 1.2.3.

Press Select in game to set 999999. The value persists in the save; turning the cheat off does not undo it. It writes game RAM, it does not patch code. The save-block address cannot be checked statically: the in-game proof was made on 1.04, not on 1.2.3.

Returns the camera to HeartGold's original angles everywhere. In 1.2.3 the camera is already native in 52 maps -- eight interiors and 44 caves -- so this code is only for players who want the original angles outdoors as well. It takes effect at the next map change; the guard checks the module signature first, so on a different ROM the code writes nothing. Guard re-read byte for byte from the 1.2.3 ARM9 image on 20 September 2026 and it matches; the in-game proof was made on 1.04 and has not been repeated on 1.2.3. The on-screen effect has still not been proved in game.

entries.source_note: Switch ONE species on in these folders and ONE level in folder 49, then hold L while walking in tall grass. This entry carries no code: switching it on does nothing. Species apply to tall grass and radio calls only, not to Surf, fishing, Rock Smash or Headbutt; alternate forms come out in their base form and Unown may not appear. No Master Balls to discard: the classic method stays in folder 40.

Switch this on plus one entry from folder 49 (level), then hold L while walking in tall grass. Tall grass and radio calls only.
